items.mainDefect: disable.ts checks only that req.body.backupCode is truthy before calling replaceAll on it, so a non-string body value throws a TypeError and returns a 500 instead of a 400.

secondary.defect: The login authorize flow in next-auth-options.ts:144 calls credentials.backupCode.replaceAll the same way, without checking that backupCode is a string.
